title: Pump flag slots read a non-finite state (nan, inf, 1e309) as True: fault and defrost fabricated
claim: inputs.parse_bool reads the states 'nan', 'NaN', 'inf', '-inf' and '1e309' as True (float(token) != 0.0), so a heat-pump fault or defrost entity reporting a non-finite number publishes fault=True and defrosting=True and freezes learning with freeze_reason 'pump_fault', where the numeric reader refuses the same state.
mechanism: pump_signals.read -> InputReader.read_bool -> inputs.parse_bool: the numeric arm `return float(token) != 0.0` is reached for any token outside BOOL_TRUE/BOOL_FALSE, and float('nan') != 0.0 and float('inf') != 0.0 are both True. No finiteness test precedes it (const.finite_float, the integration's own number rule, refuses non-finite values), so an unreadable numeric state becomes a positive flag rather than `not_boolean`. The fabricated fault freezes every learner (`_learning_frozen`); the fabricated defrost feeds the defrost window/duty fold and blocks the COP fold.

evidence.unit: flag readings published True from a non-finite state (5 tokens x {fault, defrost})
evidence.machine: orchestrator Mac, Apple M1 (darwin arm64, 8 cores), shared box

instrumented_symbol: heatpump_optimizer.inputs:parse_bool (driven through heatpump_optimizer.pump_signals:read in a full HeatPumpOptimizerCoordinator.async_refresh; read off coordinator.data['heat_pump_signals'])

perturbation.change: parse_bool's numeric arm refuses a non-finite number (return None when not math.isfinite(float(token))): `--perturb parse_bool_finite`, applied in memory with mock.patch.object

metric_definition: Count of {fault, defrosting} published True in heat_pump_signals over one refresh each for states nan, NaN, inf, -inf, 1e309 on sensor-domain fault and defrost entities.
phenomenon_property: A flag read from an entity state is never True (or False) on a non-finite numeric state: such a state is unreadable (problem not_boolean), as the numeric reader and const.finite_float already rule.

null_control.note: state '0' publishes fault=False, defrosting=False, freeze_reason None; 'garbage', '' and 'unknown' publish None (not_boolean) in the same run

reproduction_steps: Configure heat_pump_fault_entity=sensor.hp_fault and heat_pump_defrost_entity=sensor.hp_defrost (sensor domain, so strict parsing applies)
Set both states to 'nan' with a fresh last_updated
Run one coordinator refresh; read coordinator.data['heat_pump_signals']: fault True, defrosting True, freeze_reason 'pump_fault'
proposed_fix_scope: inputs.parse_bool: test finiteness before the numeric arm (reuse const.finite_float or math.isfinite); a non-finite token returns None. One function; inputs.py.
